ruff_missing: Ruff is not installed ({detail}). Run: jgates doctor --fix (or pip install ruff in the project's Python environment).
ruff_probe_failed: Ruff at {path} did not answer --version. Reinstall with: jgates doctor --fix.
ruff_timeout: Ruff exceeded the limit of {seconds} s and was ended.
ruff_invalid_output: The Ruff output is not the expected JSON list: {detail}
ruff_no_invocation: The plan has no Ruff invocation for the instance {tool}.
ruff_condition_container: Runs in the container runner, in the image {image}: network off, workspace read-only, cache in the run folder.
ruff_container_runtime_missing: The container runner needs Docker, and {runtime} was not found on the PATH (or set JGATES_CONTAINER_RUNTIME).
ruff_container_image_unprepared: Ruff ({instance}) has runner: container, but the image has not been prepared yet: run {command} (it writes the image by digest and the version to .jgates/lock.json).
ruff_container_lock_invalid: .jgates/lock.json is not valid ({detail}), and the Ruff image comes only from it. Fix or delete the file and run {command}.
ruff_container_image_missing: The image {image} pinned in .jgates/lock.json for {instance} is not in the container runtime ({detail}). Run {command} again.
ruff_container_image_changed: The image {image} no longer states the version pinned in .jgates/lock.json ({detail}). Run {command} again.
